logCommands.name: app
logCommands.command: out=$(kubectl --kubeconfig "$CM_ENV_LOG_KUBECONFIG" logs --selector 'app.kubernetes.io/name in (twenty-server,twenty-worker)' --all-containers --prefix --since=6h --tail=500 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out"; exit 1; }; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -v '^No resources found' || true

logCommands.name: warnings
logCommands.command:
out=$(kubectl --kubeconfig "$CM_ENV_LOG_KUBECONFIG" get events --field-selector type=Warning --sort-by=.lastTimestamp 2>&1) || { printf '%s
' "$out"; exit 1; }; pods=$(kubectl --kubeconfig "$CM_ENV_LOG_KUBECONFIG" get pods -o json 2>&1) || { printf '%s
' "$pods"; exit 1; }; printf '%s
' "$out" | grep -v '^No resources found' || true; printf '%s
' "$pods" | jq -r '.items[] | .metadata.name as $pod | (.status.initContainerStatuses // [])[], (.status.containerStatuses // [])[] | (.state.terminated // .lastState.terminated) as $t | select($t != null and $t.reason != "Completed") | "last termination: pod=\($pod) container=\(.name) reason=\($t.reason // "none") exit=\($t.exitCode) finishedAt=\($t.finishedAt) restarts=\(.restartCount)"'

logCommands.name: resources
logCommands.command:
: "${CM_ENV_PROMETHEUS_URL:?is not set: the platform hands it where CM_K8S_PROMETHEUS_URL is set}"; ns=${CM_ENV_NAMESPACE:?is not set}; h='[bcdfghjklmnpqrstvwxz2456789]'; wl() { printf 'label_replace(label_replace(%s, "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "workload", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(-[0-9]{8})?(-%s{6,10})?-%s{5}")' "$1" "$h" "$h"; }; q() { out=$(curl -sS --fail-with-body --max-time 25 "$CM_ENV_PROMETHEUS_URL/api/v1/query" --data-urlencode "query=$2" 2>&1) && res=$(printf '%s
' "$out" | jq -r --arg what "$1" '.data.result[] | "\($what) \(.metric | to_entries | map("\(.key)=\(.value)") | join(" ")) \(.value[1])"' 2>&1) || { printf '%s: %s
' "$1" "$out"; exit 1; }; [ -z "$res" ] || printf '%s
' "$res"; }; q oom_kills_24h "round(sum by (workload, container) ($(wl "increase(container_oom_events_total{namespace="$ns",container!=""}[24h])"))) > 0"; q memory_peak_of_limit_7d "round(max by (workload, container) ($(wl "max by (pod, container) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="$ns",container!=""}[7d])) / on (pod, container) max by (pod, container) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="$ns",resource="memory"}[7d]))")) > 0.8, 0.01)"; q cpu_throttled_share_24h "round(sum by (workload, container) ($(wl "increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="$ns",container!=""}[24h])")) / sum by (workload, container) ($(wl "increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="$ns",container!=""}[24h])")) > 0.25, 0.01)"; q failed_jobs_24h "count by (cronjob) (label_replace((max by (job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_failed{namespace="$ns",condition="true"}[24h])) == 1 and on (job_name) max by (job_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_created{namespace="$ns"}[24h])) > time() - 86400) * on (job_name) group_left (owner_name) max by (job_name, owner_name) (max_over_time(kube_job_owner{namespace="$ns",owner_kind="CronJob"}[24h])), "cronjob", "\$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"))"
